from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import ast, hashlib, itertools, json, re, shlex, subprocess, textwrap
root=Path.cwd()
task=root/"reports/T0007"
baseline=json.loads((task/"planning-baseline.json").read_text())
def sha(data): return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
assert baseline["status"]==""
assert baseline["head"]=="74a96f3735831d16a14dedffbaa6e0654f8b7658"
allowed={"docs/decisions.md","docs/handoffs/T0006-proof-verifier.md","docs/implementation_status.md"}
for p,h in baseline["tracked_sha256"].items():
    if p not in allowed:
        assert sha(Path(p).read_bytes())==h,p
accepted=json.loads(Path("reports/T0006/review-r3/final-audit.json").read_text())["accepted_files"]
for p,h in accepted.items():
    assert sha(Path(p).read_bytes())==h
    for commit in ("df0ee6732ede7b484bd2cf729143fae7c4e79c1c",baseline["head"]):
        assert sha(subprocess.check_output(["git","show",commit+":"+p]))==h
assert not Path("src/kmesh/logic/dependency.py").exists()
assert not Path("tests/test_dependency.py").exists()
rec_src=(task/"record_check.py").read_text()
old_rec=Path("reports/T0006/record_check.py").read_text().replace("T0006","T0007")
assert rec_src==old_rec.replace('SOURCES = (\n','SOURCES = (\n    "src/kmesh/logic/dependency.py", "tests/test_dependency.py",\n')
tree=ast.parse(rec_src)
sources=next(ast.literal_eval(n.value) for n in tree.body if isinstance(n,ast.Assign) and any(isinstance(t,ast.Name) and t.id=="SOURCES" for t in n.targets))
assert len(sources)==17 and len(set(sources))==17
pre=json.loads((task/"planning-preflight/record.json").read_text())
assert pre["exit_code"]==0
assert pre["before"]["source_sha256"]==pre["after"]["source_sha256"]
assert pre["before"]["source_sha256"]["src/kmesh/logic/dependency.py"] is None
assert pre["before"]["source_sha256"]["tests/test_dependency.py"] is None
for stream in ("stdout","stderr"):
    assert sha((task/f"planning-preflight/{stream}.txt").read_bytes())==pre[stream+"_sha256"]
env=(task/"planning-preflight/stdout.txt").read_text()
assert all(x in env for x in ("3.13.9","0.1.0","8.4.2",str(root/"src/kmesh/__init__.py")))
doc=Path("docs/handoffs/T0007-relation-dag.md").read_text()
commands=[]
for block in re.findall(chr(96)*3+r"bash\n(.*?)"+chr(96)*3,doc,re.S):
    for line in block.splitlines():
        if not line.strip(): continue
        args=shlex.split(line)
        assert args[:2]==[".venv/bin/python","reports/T0007/record_check.py"]
        assert args[3]=="--"
        assert not (task/args[2]).exists()
        if "-m" in args and "pytest" in args:
            assert args[args.index("--basetemp")+1]==f"reports/T0007/{args[2]}/pytest-tmp"
        commands.append(args)
assert len(commands)==4
python_blocks=re.findall(chr(96)*3+r"python\n(.*?)"+chr(96)*3,doc,re.S)
for i,b in enumerate(python_blocks): compile(textwrap.dedent(b),f"<handoff-python-{i}>","exec")
links=0
for name in ["docs/handoffs/T0007-relation-dag.md","docs/decisions.md","docs/handoffs/T0006-proof-verifier.md","docs/implementation_status.md"]:
    p=Path(name);data=p.read_text()
    assert data.endswith("\n") and all(x==x.rstrip() for x in data.splitlines()),name
    for link in re.findall(r"\]\(([^)]+)\)",data):
        target=link.split("#",1)[0]
        if target and not re.match(r"^[a-zA-Z]+:",target):
            assert (p.parent/target).exists(),(name,link)
            links+=1
# Independently check the small table's claimed orders by exhaustive permutations.
# This is a planning check of specified graphs, not the delivered algorithm.
cases=[
("empty",(),(),()),
("facts",("z","p"),(),("p","z")),
("body-only",("p","q"),(("p","q"),),("p","q")),
("main",("r1","r2","r3","r4"),(("r1","r3"),("r2","r3"),("r3","r4")),("r1","r2","r3","r4")),
("direction",("z","a"),(("z","a"),),("z","a")),
("new-ready",("a","z","b"),(("a","b"),),("a","b","z")),
("two-premises",("z","p","a"),(("z","a"),("p","a")),("p","z","a")),
("duplicate-edge",("p","q"),(("p","q"),("p","q")),("p","q")),
("case",("A","a","z"),(),("A","a","z")),
]
for name,vertices,edges,expected in cases:
    candidates=[p for p in itertools.permutations(vertices) if all(p.index(u)<p.index(v) for u,v in edges)]
    assert min(candidates)==expected,name
cycles=[
(("p",),(("p","p"),)),
(("p","q"),(("p","q"),("q","p"))),
(("p","q","r"),(("p","q"),("q","r"),("r","p"))),
(("a","b","q","r"),(("a","b"),("q","r"),("r","q"))),
(("p","q","z"),(("p","q"),("q","p"),("q","z"))),
(("p","q"),(("p","q"),("q","q"))),
(("p","q"),(("p","q"),("q","p"))),
]
for vertices,edges in cycles:
    assert not any(all(p.index(u)<p.index(v) for u,v in edges) for p in itertools.permutations(vertices))
diff=subprocess.run(["git","diff","--check"],capture_output=True,text=True)
assert diff.returncode==0,diff.stdout+diff.stderr
report={"checked_at_utc":datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),"result":"PASS",
"stage":"draft_contract_validation","baseline":baseline["head"],
"tracked_files_preserved_except_allowed_docs":len(baseline["tracked_sha256"])-len(allowed),
"accepted_T0006_commit_and_merge_hashes":accepted,"recorder_sources":len(sources),
"preflight":"PASS","command_count":len(commands),"python_blocks":len(python_blocks),
"local_links":links,"hand_table_orders":len(cases),"cycle_graphs":len(cycles),
"product_and_test_not_created":True,"product_acceptance":"not_run"}
(task/"planning-checks/checks.json").write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n")
print(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
